read.thesis: Cognizant Q2 CY26 is a services-demand story, not a supply-side one: revenue +4.1% CC, Q2 bookings down 6% y/y, and FY26 CC growth guidance cut to 4.0-5.5%, though EPS guidance rose on buybacks and a one-off benefit.

triggers.label: Q2 bookings down 6% y/y
triggers.quote: Bookings in the second quarter declined 6% year-over-year.

triggers.label: FY26 CC growth cut to 4.0-5.5%
triggers.quote: 2026 constant currency revenue growth guidance is revised to 4.0% to 5.5% year-over-year growth

triggers.label: Financial Services +12% y/y
triggers.quote: 12% year-over-year revenue growth in Financial Services

guidance.quote: 2026 constant currency revenue growth guidance is revised to 4.0% to 5.5% year-over-year growth
2026 Adjusted Operating Margin guidance is unchanged at 16.0% to 16.2%
2026 Adjusted Diluted EPS guidance is increased to $5.70 to $5.82
Third quarter revenue is expected to be $5.60 to $5.68 billion
We expect to incur costs of $230 million to $320 million in connection with Project Leap
